Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১) Choose the synonym of 'Cardinal'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Cardinal (adjective): 
English Meaning: Serving as an essential component. a cardinal rule.
Bangla Meaning: প্রধান; মুখ্য; অগ্রগণ্য; অপরিহার্য: the cardinal virtues.

Synonyms: Fundamental (মৌলিক), Chief (প্রধান), Paramount (সর্বোচ্চ), Central (কেন্দ্রীয়), Dominant (প্রভাবশালী)। 
Antonyms: Unimportant (কম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ), inessential (অপরিহার্য নয় এমন), Auxiliary, (সহায়ক) Unmercenary (অপ্রয়োজনীয়), Least (ন্যুনতম)।

Other Forms: - Cardinal (Noun) (Roman Catholic Church) one of a group of more than 100 prominent bishops in the Sacred College who advise the Pope and elect new Popes. 
- The number of elements in a mathematical set; denotes a quantity but not the order
Example Sentence: 
1. One of the most popular presidents in recent memory is about to commit a cardinal sin.
2. My cardinal rule is to always be honest. 

• Incite - প্ররোচিত করা।  

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question:
২) Complete the sentence using an appropriate idiom. </br>
We arrived late and didn't have much time to ______ before dinner.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Look round:
English Meaning: to go through a place in order to see what is there / to explore a place.
Bangla Meaning: চারদিকে ঘুরে দেখা / খুঁটিয়ে খুঁটিয়ে দেখা।

Ex. Sentence: The kids looked round the shops while we were shopping.
Bangla Meaning: আমরা যখন কেনাকাটা করছিলাম বাচ্চারা তখন ঘুরে ঘুরে দেখছিলো।

Complete Sentence - We arrived late and didn't have much time to look round before dinner.

Other options, 
Look over / look through something - দ্রুততার সাথে পরিদর্শন করা / পরীক্ষা করা।
Look into (something) - তদন্ত করা / পরীক্ষা করে দেখা / খতিয়ে দেখা।

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৩) What is the last word of the proverb - One man’s meat is another man’s ______?
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
Proverb:
One man’s meat is another man’s poison - একজনের কাছে যা খেলা, অন্যের কাছে তা মৃত্যু।
Example - Sarah loves spicy food, but for Mark, it's one man's meat is another man's poison as he can't handle any heat in his meals.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৪) Find out the antonym of 'Emulate'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Emulate (verb): 
English Meaning: Try to do something as well as somebody else because you admire them.
Bangla Meaning: সমকক্ষ হতে অথবা ছাড়িয়ে যেতে চেষ্টা করা।

Synonyms: Compete (পাল্লা দেয়া, প্রতিযোগীতা করা), Imitate (অনুসরণ করা) Mimic (নকল করা), Follow (অনুগমন করা), Mirror (প্রতিফলিত করা)। 
Antonyms: Being original (মৌলিক হওয়া বা করা), Contradict (আলাদা হওয়া), Neglect (অবজ্ঞা করা), Originate (স্বকীয়তা বজায় রাখা), Differ (আলাদা হওয়া)।  

Other Forms: 
- Emulation (Noun)
- Emulative (Adjective) 
Example Sentence: 
1. She hopes to emulate her sister's sporting achievements.
2. She grew up emulating her sports heroes. 

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৫) What is the meaning of the proverb 'Chance of requital is never lost.'?
Vocabulary-Booster.option1: ক) মুখে বুলি লম্বা, কাজে অষ্টরম্ভা।
Vocabulary-Booster.option3: গ) এক মাঘে শীত যায় না।
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
Proverb:
One swallow does not make a summer / Chance of requital is never lost - এক মাঘে শীত যায় না।

Other options,
মুখে বুলি লম্বা, কাজে অষ্টরম্ভা - Great talkers are little doers.
সাহসীদের প্রতি ভাগ্য সুপ্রসন্ন - Fortune favours the brave.
সবজান্তা অষ্টরম্ভা - Jack of all trades, master of none.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৬) Choose the parts of speech of the word 'Fetid'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Fetid (Adjective): 
English Meaning: Smelling very unpleasant.
Bangla Meaning: পূঁতিগন্ধময়।

Synonyms: Smelly (দূর্গন্ধযুক্ত), Stinky (কটূ গন্ধ), Filthy (ময়লা), Musty (টক টক গন্ধ), Reeky (ধূমময়)। 
Antonyms: Perfumed (সুগন্ধযুক্ত), Aromatic (সুরভিময়), Fragrant (সুবাস), Savoury (সুস্বাদু), Scented (সুগন্ধি)। 

Other Forms:  
- Fetidness (noun); - Fetidly (adverb)
Example Sentence: 
1. She tried to inhale as little of the fetid air as possible.
2. The fetid odor of rotting vegetables.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৭) What is the last word of the proverb - Out of sight, out of ______?
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
Proverb:
Out of sight, out of mind - কাছে তুমি পোড়ে মন দূরে গেলে ঠনঠন / চোখের আড়াল হলে স্মৃতিরও আড়াল হয়ে যায়।
Example - After moving to a new city, Sarah gradually lost touch with her old friends back home because, as they say, "out of sight, out of mind".

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৮) Choose the opposite word of 'Nexus'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Nexus (noun): 
English Meaning: An important connection between the parts of a system or a group of things.
Bangla Meaning: সংযোগ; বন্ধন; সম্বন্ধ; পরস্পরসম্বন্ধ শ্রেণি।

Synonyms: Connection (সংযোগ), Bond (যুক্ত করা), Join (এক করা), Chain (শিকল), String (বাঁধা, জোড়), Link (সংযুক্তি)। 
Antonyms: Separation (বিচ্ছিন্ন করা), Split (আলাদা হওয়া বা আলাদা করা), Division (মতনৈক্য), Divorce (বিচ্ছেদ), Disunion (বিভেদ)। 

Example Sentence: 
1. Times Square is the nexus of the New York Subway.
2. As the nexus for three great religions, Jerusalem has had a troubled and illustrious history.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ৯) Which of the following idioms represent the meaning 'fail to advance'?
Vocabulary-Booster.option4: ঘ) Look to someone to do
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Lose ground:
English Meaning: to become less popular or to be given less support / fail to advance or improve.
Bangla Meaning: জনপ্রিয়তা হারানো / উন্নতি করতে না পারা।

Ex. Sentence: In Bangladesh football is losing ground.
Bangla Meaning: বাংলাদেশে ফুটবলের জনপ্রিয়তা হারাচ্ছে।

Other options, 
Look up to - have a great deal of respect for (someone).
Look something out - to search for and find something.
Look to someone to do (something) - to hope that someone will do something for.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১০) Find out the synonym of 'Fulsome'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Fulsome (Adjective):
English Meaning: Too generous in praising or thanking somebody, or in saying sorry, so that you do not sound sincere.
Bangla Meaning: (প্রশংসা, তোষামোদ ইত্যাদি) অত্যধিক এবং কপট; ন্যক্কারজনক; অতিবিগলিত; গদগদ।

Synonyms: Excessive (অতিরিক্ত), Exaggerated (অতিরঞ্জন), Gushy (তেলতেলে), Oily (তোষামোদপূর্ণ), Soapy (ভক্তি মনোরঞ্জনমূলক)।
Antonyms: Sincere (বস্তুনিষ্ঠ), Honest (সৎ), Unflattering (তোষামোদীমুক্ত), Reasonable (যৌক্তিক), Genuine (খাঁটি, প্রকৃত)। 

Other Forms: 
- fulsomely (adverb) ন্যক্কারজনকভাবে; অতিবিগলিতভাবে।
- fulsomeness (noun) আতিরেক্য; ন্যক্কারজনকতা।
Example Sentence: 
1. Our guests were fulsome in their compliments about the food, for sure.
2. Grateful survivors who were fulsome in their praise of the rescue team.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১১) What does 'Made-up' mean in English?
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Made-up:
English Meaning: fancifully conceived or falsely devised/wearing make-up / fully manufactured.
Bangla Meaning: বানোয়াট / কৃত্রিম।

Ex. Sentence: I don’t believe it, it is a made-up story.
Bangla Meaning: এ আমি বিশ্বাস করি না, এটা একটা বানোয়াট গল্প।

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১২) Choose the correct spelling.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Onerous (adjective):
English Meaning: Needing great effort; causing trouble or worry.
Bangla Meaning: কষ্টসাধ্য; গুরুভার: an onerous duty/task/responsibility. 

Synonyms: Arduous (দু:সাধ্য), Difficult (কষ্টকর), Hard(কঠিন), Tough (শ্রমসাধ্য), Burdensome (বোঝাস্বরুপ)। 
Antonyms: Easy (সহজ), Effortless (বিনা প্রচেষ্টায়), Achievable (সহজে অর্জন করা যায় না এমন), Light (হালকা), Soft (নরম)। 

Other Forms: 
- Onerously (adverb)- In an onerous manner. 
- Onerousness.
Example Sentence: 
1. The new rules will place onerous responsibilities on employers.
2. The government imposed onerous taxes on imports.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১৩) The word 'Hermetic' is a/an -
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Hermetic (adjective):
English Meaning: (of a container) so tightly closed that no air can leave or enter.
Bangla Meaning: সম্পূর্ণরূপে বাতাভেদ্য: a hermetic seal; দুর্বোধ্য; a hermetic poem.

Synonyms: Sealed (চতুর্দিক বন্ধ করে দেয়া/ভালোভাবে বন্ধ করে দেয়া), Deep (গভীর), Shut tight (আঁটসাঁট), Profound (প্রগাঢ়), Recondite (পূননির্মান)।  
Antonyms: Open (খোলা), Easy (সহজ), Shallow (অগভীর), Simple (ভাসা ভাসা) Ajar (ঈষৎ খোলা), Straightforward (অকপট, সোজাসুজি)।

Other Forms: hermetically [হামেটিক্‌লি] (adverb) বাতাভেদ্যরূপে: hermetically sealed.
Example Sentence: 
1. Lids are attached using the company's Ultra seal technology, which produces a hermetic seal in less than 2 seconds.
2. Efforts to keep that hermetic seal are getting more desperate.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১৪) What is the meaning of the idiom 'Make a killing'?
Vocabulary-Booster.option1: ক) To earn the money one needs to pay for living.
Vocabulary-Booster.option2: খ) To earn a lot of money in a short time.
Vocabulary-Booster.option3: গ) To argue with someone over something.
Vocabulary-Booster.option4: ঘ) To argue that something is the best thing to do.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Make a killing: 
English Meaning: to earn a lot of money in a short time and with little effort / have great financial success.
Bangla Meaning: অর্থোপার্জনে অসাধারণ সাফল্য লাভ করা। 

Ex. Sentence: They made a killing with the sale of their London house.
Bangla Meaning: তারা তাদের লন্ডনের বাড়িটা বিক্রি করে অনেক লাভবান হয়েছে।

Other options, 
Make a living - to earn money one needs to pay for housing, food, etc. 
Make a case for something - To argue that something is the best thing to do.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১৫) Select the synonym of 'Proliferate'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Proliferate (verb): 
English Meaning: To increase a lot and suddenly in number.
Bangla Meaning: 
(১) কোষ, নতুন অঙ্গ ইত্যাদির দ্রুত সংখ্যাবৃদ্ধির দ্বারা বেড়ে ওঠা বা বংশবিস্তার করা; দ্রুত বিস্তারলাভ করা; দ্রুত বেড়ে ওঠা; দ্রুত বিস্তৃত করা।
(২) (কোষ ইত্যাদি) জন্ম দেওয়া/প্রত্যুৎপন্ন করা।

Synonyms: Multiply (বেড়ে যাওয়া), Escalate (দ্রুত সঞ্চালন), Increase (বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া), Accelerate (উত্তরোত্তর গতি বৃদ্ধি করা), Accumulate, (সঞ্চিত করা)। 
Antonyms: Decrease (কমা), Diminish (ক্ষয়ে যাওয়া), Lessen (কমে যাওয়া), Dwindle (হ্রাস পাওয়া), Recede (ক্ষীণ হওয়া)। 

Other Forms: - Proliferation [প্রালিফারেইশ্‌ন্‌ America(n) প্রোলিফারেইশ্‌ন্‌] (noun) দ্রুতবিস্তার; দ্রুত বংশবিস্তার/বংশবৃদ্ধি।
Example Sentence: 
1. Small businesses have proliferated in the last ten years. 
2. This is an important element as advertiser opportunities continue to proliferate in the years ahead.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১৬) What does the phrase 'Make good' mean?
Vocabulary-Booster.option1: ক) To fail and become poor.
Vocabulary-Booster.option2: খ) To achieve an average level of success.
Vocabulary-Booster.option4: ঘ) To succeed and become rich.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Make good: 
English Meaning: to succeed and become rich.
Bangla Meaning: সফল হওয়া।

Ex. Sentence: A working-class boy made good.
Bangla Meaning: একটি শ্রমিক শ্রেণির ছেলে জীবনে সফল হয়েছে।

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১৭) Choose the opposite meaning of 'Prate'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Prate (verb): 
English Meaning: to talk stupidly, or about things that are not important, for a long time.
Bangla Meaning: বোকার মতো বকবক করা; বাজে বকা।

Synonyms: Chatter (বক বক করা), Babble (হড়বড় করে কথা বলা), Jabber (বেশি কথা বলা), Cackle (প্যাঁক প্যাঁক করা), Clatter (শোরগোল করা)। 
Antonyms: Shorten (কথা ছোট করা), Silence (নীরবতা), Curtail (সঙ্কুচিত করা), Reduce (কমানো), Go direct (মূল কথা বলা)। 

Other Forms: - Prater (Noun)
Example Sentence: 
1. Inevitably there's some caller prating on about the decline in moral standards.
2. The young executive gratingly prated on about his weekend hobnobbing with the rich. 

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ১৮) Choose the meaning of the word 'Subpoena'.
Vocabulary-Booster.option1: ক) To order someone to attend a social event.
Vocabulary-Booster.option2: খ) To order someone to appear in a law court and answer questions.
Vocabulary-Booster.option3: গ) To request a favor from a friend or colleague.
Vocabulary-Booster.option4: ঘ) To order someone to perform community service.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Subpoena (noun):
English Meaning: To order someone to go to a law court to answer questions. 
Bangla Meaning: আদালতে হাজির হওয়ার জন্য লিখিত হুকুম; সপিনা; তলবনামা। 

Synonyms: Decree (আদেশ), Summons (সমন জারি), Warrant, Process (প্রক্রিয়া), Notice (বিজ্ঞপ্তি)।  
Antonyms: Ignore, Breach (লঙ্ঘন), Denial (অস্বীকার), Prohibition (নিষেধ), Refusal (প্রত্যাখ্যান)। 

Other Forms: - □(verb transitive) (past tense past participle subpoenaed) সপিনা দেওয়া/পাঠানো; তলবনামা জারি করা বা পাঠানো।
Example Sentence: 
1. They were subpoenaed to testify before the judge.
2. He was subpoenaed to testify in a hearing.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question:
১৯) Choose an appropriate idiom to complete the sentence. </br> 
Before leaving the house, _____ you turn off all the lights and lock all the doors.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Make sure: 
English Meaning: establish that something is definitely so / confirm.
Bangla Meaning: সত্যতার ব্যাপারে নিশ্চিত হওয়া।

Ex. Sentence: Make sure he's honest before you lend him any money.
Bangla Meaning: তাকে টাকা ধার দেয়ার আগে সে সৎ কিনা নিশ্চিত হয়ে নিও।

Complete Sentence: Before leaving the house, make sure you turn off all the lights and lock all the doors.

• Other options, 
Make oneself useful - do something that is of some value or benefit to someone / do something helpful.
Make up one's mind - make a decision / to decide.
Make someone’s blood boil - to make someone very angry.

Source: live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ২০) Choose the parts of speech of the 'Opprobrium'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
Opprobrium (noun): 
English Meaning: Severe criticism and blame.
Bangla Meaning: চরম অপমান, নিন্দা, কলঙ্ক। 

Synonyms: Disgrace (লজ্জাস্কর), Shame, infamy (কুখ্যাত, নিন্দনীয়) Reproach (তিরষ্কার), Scandal (কলঙ্ক)। 
Antonyms: Honor(সম্মানজনক), Respect, Glory (গৌরব), Pride (আত্মতৃপ্তি), Esteem (সম্মান, আত্মমর্যাদা), Credit (কৃতিত্ব)। 

Other Forms: Opprobrious (Adjective). 
Example Sentence: 
1. International opprobrium has been heaped on the country following its attack on its neighbors.
2. The plan flopped in the face of opprobrium from fans and national governments.

Source: live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ২১) Choose the synonym of 'Regale'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Regale (verb):
English Meaning: to entertain someone with stories or jokes or something that delights. 
Bangla Meaning: সুখ বা আনন্দ দান করা; পরিতৃপ্ত/চরিতার্থ করা: regale oneself with a bottle of champagne.

Synonyms: Entertain (বিনোদিত করা), Amuse (আনন্দ দেয়া), Satisfy (পরিতৃপ্ত করা), Solace (সান্তনা), Disport (মজা করা)। 
Antonyms: Bore (একঘেয়ে, বিরক্তিকর), Annoy (রাগানো), Disturb (বিক্ষুব্ধ করা), Pain (ব্যাথা দেয়া), Distress (বেদনা)। 

Other Forms: Regalement (Noun)
Example Sentence: 
1. Grandpa regaled us with tales of his small-town childhood.
2. An inn that nightly regales its guests with five-course meals prepared by a master chef. 

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ২২) Which word represents the opposite meaning of 'Dissident'?
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Dissident (adjective): 
English Meaning: 
- A person who publicly disagrees with and criticizes their government.
- Critic of conventional or official policy. 
Bangla Meaning: ভিন্নমতাবলম্বী।

Synonyms: Unorthodox (প্রচলিত ধারার বাইরে), Rebellious (বিদ্রোহী), Nonconformist (প্রথাবিরোধী), Sectarian (সাম্প্রদায়িক), Heretical (ধর্মবিরোধী)। 
Antonyms: Agreeing সম্মত হওয়া), Conforming (প্রথা মেনে চলা), Orthodox (সনাতন), Established (প্রতিষ্ঠিত), Customary (গতানুগতিক)। 

Other Forms: 
- Dissidence (noun) ভিন্নমত; 
- Dissidently (Adverb)
Example Sentence: 
1. Captain was able to offer his small and relatively inexpensive force as a cost-effective way to keep dissident colonials in check.
2. It is widely recognized that dissident elements within the Catholic Church should be reformed.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ২৩) What does the expression "Meet one's Waterloo" mean?
Vocabulary-Booster.option1: ক) To achieve great success through hard work.
Vocabulary-Booster.option2: খ) To face a challenging situation with determination.
Vocabulary-Booster.option3: গ) To be defeated by someone who is too strong for oneself.
Vocabulary-Booster.option4: ঘ) To overcome obstacles and emerge victorious.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Meet one's Waterloo: 
English Meaning: To be defeated by someone who is too strong for someone.
Bangla Meaning: শক্তিশালী প্রতিপক্ষের কাছে পরাজিত হওয়া।

Ex. Sentence: The governor finally met his Waterloo in the last election.
Bangla Meaning: গত নির্বাচনে গভর্নর চূড়ান্তভাবে পরাজিত হয়েছে।

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ২৪) Which word is similar to 'Tirade'?
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Tirade (noun): 
English Meaning: A long, angry speech expressing strong disapproval. 
Bangla Meaning: দীর্ঘ, ক্রোধোদ্দীপ্ত বা তিরস্কারপূর্ণ বক্তৃতা।

Synonyms: Violent speech (সহিংসতা উদ্রেক করা বক্তব্য), Dispute (বিতর্ক), Angry statement (রাগান্বিত বক্তব্য), Jeremiad (বিষাদগ্রস্ত অনুযোগ), Philippic (কুৎসাপূর্ণ বক্তৃতা)। 
Antonyms: Panegyric (প্রসংসা, স্তুতি জ্ঞাপক বক্তব্য), Harmony (সম্প্রীতি), Peaceful speech, Recommendation (অনুমোদন), Eulogy (প্রশংসা পত্র)।  

Other Forms: - 
Example Sentence: 
1. She launched into an angry/furious tirade about how she had been unfairly treated.
2. The coach directed a tirade at the team after the loss.

• Accolade - জয়ধ্বনি।

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Vocabulary-Booster.question: ২৫) Choose the antonym of 'Necromancy'.
Vocabulary-Booster.exp:
• Necromancy (noun): 
English Meaning: - 
1. The practice of claiming to communicate by magic with the dead in order to learn about the future.
2. The use of magic powers, especially evil ones. 
Bangla Meaning: ভবিষ্যৎ জানার জন্য জাদুবিদ্যার সাহায্যে মৃতের সঙ্গে আলাপ করার বিদ্যা বা রীতি; প্রেতসিদ্ধি।

Synonyms: Enchantment (বশীকরণ), Magic (জাদু), Sorcery (ইন্দ্রজাল), Black Magic (কালো জাদু), Witchcraft (জাদুবিদ্যা)। 
Antonyms: Science (বিজ্ঞান), Logic (যুক্তি), Rationality (যৌক্তিকতা), Reality (বাস্তবতা), Fact (তথ্য)। 

Other Forms: 
- Necromancer (Noun)= The one who practices Necromancy. 
- Necromantical (Adjective). 
Example Sentence: 
1. It will tell you everything that you will need to know about necromancy and Death.
2. The town accused her of witchcraft and necromancy.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.
